description: Réseau de surveillance des eaux usées, état 18 août 2014 is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agentschap Digitaal Vlaanderen. This dataset contains all active discharging measuring wells. Coverage: Agentschap Digitaal Vlaanderen. The portal shows the English title as "Wastewater monitoring network, condition 18 August 2014" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agentschap Digitaal Vlaanderen. Its keywords include Raadpleegdienst, VMM, WFS, Web Feature Service, WMS, AGIV-Product. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
